summary: Tested service creation/edit form for lazy upload and tags pre-fill bugs. Backend tests: 12/12 passed. Frontend: Edit service form loads correctly with all fields. Lazy upload pattern verified via code review. Tags pre-fill working (shows '4 tags sélectionnés') but data integrity issue exists - service has tags from wrong domain.

ui_bugs.issue: EditServiceRedirect throws 'Attempted to navigate before mounting Root Layout' error when accessed directly via URL. The useEffect with router.replace runs before root layout mounts.

integration_issues.issue: Service svc_demo001 has 4 tags selected (shown in banner as '4 tags sélectionnés') but only 1 tag (Coach personnel) is visible in tag picker. 3 tags (musculation, cardio, hiit) belong to dom_sport but service uses dom_coaching domain. This is DATA INTEGRITY issue, not code bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix edit-service/[id].tsx redirect - add isMounted check or use setTimeout/InteractionManager to delay router.replace until root layout is ready

DATA FIX: Service svc_demo001 has cross-domain tags (tag_musculation, tag_cardio, tag_hiit from dom_sport but domain is dom_coaching). Either update service domain to dom_sport OR change tags to dom_coaching tags.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 (Lazy Upload) VERIFIED: pickImages() at line 173-191 only stores local URIs, NOT calling uploadImage. Upload only happens in handleSubmit() at line 372-378. Pattern is correct.

Bug Fix 2 (Tags Pre-fill) VERIFIED: loadServiceForEdit() lines 269-281 correctly handles both cases - direct setSelectedTagIds when domain matches default, or pendingTagIdsRef when domain differs. The code is correct.
edit-service/[id].tsx line 15-22: useEffect runs router.replace() immediately which can race with root layout mounting. Consider adding isReady check or using setTimeout(0) for safety.

success_rate.frontend: 90% - edit form loads and pre-fills correctly, minor redirect issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: Service edit form tested. svc_demo001 used for testing has data integrity issue: domain is dom_coaching but 3/4 tags belong to dom_sport. The tags ARE being loaded (banner shows 4 selected) but not all visible in picker due to cross-domain tags. Lazy upload pattern confirmed correct via code review - pickImages stores local URIs, handleSubmit does the R2 upload.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (Lazy Upload): Code is correct - pickImages() only stores URIs, uploadImage() only called in handleSubmit(). Bug 2 (Tags Pre-fill): Code is correct - uses pendingTagIdsRef pattern. The 'only 1 tag visible' issue is due to test data having tags from wrong domain (dom_sport tags on dom_coaching service). Edit-service redirect error: useEffect with router.replace races with root layout mounting.
